name: Festival Stone of Harvestgain
title: Festival Stone of Harvestgain
summary: One of the Festival Stones, near the Gharu'n town of Uziz (acpedia/Alatar Locke). In the kit the stone and its glow stand on the flat desert floor (z 26) between two 3 m candle sentinels (Master's Sentinel 0x0200039B), among desert shrubs, at the foot of a long rock slope that climbs 100 m to the west.

shots.standingOrder: Rise 8 m straight up from low among the desert shrubs 14.5 m east of the glowing Harvestgain stone and its two candle sentinels until the long rock slope climbs behind them; keep 3.5 m from every shrub, creatures may be faded.
shots.notes: Pedestal at the Harvestgain Festival Stone, which stands with its glow and two candle sentinels on the desert floor at the foot of a long rock slope climbing 100 m to the west: the camera rises out of the shrubs so the stone stays framed while the slope and sky open behind it; noon sun high in the south lights it from the left.
